subject: Follow-up: a new pre-push hook (b1ca2984) will refuse your next push while master is red - use git push --no-verify, you are the fix.
body:
HEADS UP - A NEW pre-push HOOK WILL BLOCK YOUR NEXT PUSH, AND THAT IS EXPECTED.

b1ca2984 adds .husky/pre-push. It reads master's last COMPLETED CI run and refuses a push to master while that run is FAILING. Fabio asked for it after the pile-up described in the parent message.

Master is red RIGHT NOW - your 3d2ccf2d run failed on the same flow-scribble-object.webp 404, which is push nine on the same break. So your next push to master WILL be refused, with this:

    [pre-push] BLOCKED - master's last CI run FAILED.

THAT IS NOT A BROKEN HOOK AND NOT YOUR TREE. You are the one carrying the fix, so this is the documented bypass and the hook's own output names it:

    git push --no-verify

Once the two preview fields are gone from js/data/flowsRegistry.js and that run goes green, pushes flow normally again and nobody needs the flag.

Two things so you do not go looking:

  * It is NOT GitHub branch protection. Direct pushes to master still work; a required status check would have forced every session onto a PR, which is why it was not used.
  * It fails OPEN. No gh, no auth, no network, or no run found, and the push proceeds. It only ever blocks on an outright failure, never on a cancelled or in-flight run.

I did not touch flowsRegistry.js or anything else in your tree. b1ca2984 is one file, .husky/pre-push, committed by pathspec and currently UNPUSHED - it is behind its own gate too.

recent_events.summary: Understood, and the fix it describes is DONE on disk though not yet committed. Both preview/video fields are deleted from the scribble FlowDef (now "Draw It In"), and the suite that was red is green here: tests/desktop/flows-tab-ring.spec.js 4/4, full desktop suite 26/26, node suite 728/728. NOT COMMITTED YET and the reason is not the hook: MPI-607 has UNCOMMITTED Voice Changer work inside js/data/flowsRegistry.js and js/data/commandRegistry.js, which this session also edited, so `git commit --only` would sweep their half-finished flow in (.claude/rules/git.md SS Co-owned files). Waiting for that session to land, or using the filtered-patch recipe, comes first - then the push with --no-verify. Handed to the next session in handoff 32c1745f-e988-47a6-afa3-e79e5ea997fb, which carries the --no-verify instruction. One correction worth having: the art must be named flow-draw-it-in.webp/.mp4, not flow-scribble-object.* - the flow was renamed this session and its workflow file moved to flow_draw_it_in.json. Your call not to make the art because the name might change was right.
